sentences.text: Today at ten fifteen a.m. Pacific, the Idaho Supreme Court hears Lori Vallow Daybell's appeal.
In twenty twenty-three, a jury convicted her of first-degree murder in the deaths of her son and daughter.
It also convicted her of conspiring to murder Tammy Daybell.
She is serving life without parole.
Today is a review, not a new trial.
Her lawyers say the judge wrongly removed the attorney she hired, and that she was denied a speedy trial.
The State asks the court to keep her convictions in place.
The justices rule later, in writing.
Court dates and sources: Cassy-an Creed dot com, slash court calendar.
